second-amendment.evidence: Voted Yea on HB 133 (2026), which repeals the 2018 law that raised the long-gun purchase age to 21 (passed the House 74-37 on 01/15/2026).

pro-life.evidence: Prime sponsor of CS/HB 1517 (2025, House 79-32 on 04/09/2025) and CS/HB 289 (2026, House 76-34 on 01/15/2026), civil wrongful-death liability for an unborn child, and voted Yea on both. The bill lets parents sue for the wrongful death of an unborn child and bars suits against the mother or against providers of lawful medical care, so it does not itself restrict abortion; abortion-rights groups opposed it.

back-police-order.evidence: Prime sponsor of CS/CS/HB 445 (2026), which requires courts to remand anyone convicted of a 'dangerous crime' to custody without bond pending sentencing; passed the House 93-20 and became Chapter 2026-19.
